method: Compared complete assigned expanded-iteration-02 and candidate04 summary snapshots. Exact diff contains only the Alliance matching-supporter reminder and Allied-benefits table/separate hit-allocation paragraph. Every revised statement checked directly against authoritative Law PDF, including supporter costs/bird wilds, Allied Aid/movement/attacking/hit allocation, force, rule and Outrage. All unchanged text retains the prior independent complete applicable-source audit, with recomputed unchanged source hashes. Only assigned summary snapshots and authoritative source text/PDF were read; no questions, keys, reader responses, grades or other reviews. No summary edited; earlier reports preserved.

checked_claims.details: Every supporter spent on Revolt or Spread Sympathy must match the target clearing, including the additional Martial Law supporter; birds can substitute. The existing action order and printed-cost requirements remain accurate.
Subsequent Aid after obtaining Allied status scores two VP. No earlier relationship-improvement scoring is changed.

When the Vagabond moves to a destination clearing, warriors of one Allied faction may be forced to accompany it. Those warriors retain their own movement restrictions, including rule and Eyrie tie advantage. Moves specified to be alone do not carry allies. Allied warriors moved into sympathy trigger Outrage.

At the start of battle as attacker only, warriors of one ally in the clearing may be treated as own; rolled-hit cap adds those warriors to total undamaged swords. The ally cannot be used to attack itself.
In battle using Allied warriors as own, hits may be taken by removing them or by damaging items. This accurately preserves the optional hit allocation.

checked_claims.area: Allied loss hostility threshold and timing
checked_claims.details: More allied warriors removed as hits than items damaged causes that ally to become Hostile at battle end, overriding ordinary immediate hostility for those allied losses. Equal numbers do not satisfy the strict greater-than threshold.
